introduction.title: Store geometry with controlled coordinate precision
paragraphs: GeoSilo adds a compact geometry type that stores scaled integer coordinates and the differences between nearby vertices. You choose the coordinate scale, which determines the precision retained by the encoding.

Use it when storing large geometry datasets and controlling their size matters. The extension supplies native operations for its GEOSILO values and converts to GEOMETRY for other spatial operations. Check the precision and resulting storage size on your own data before adopting the format.
